title: base_url validation: four structural checks instead of one named invariant
description: client.rs lines 54-80: JmapClient::new validates base_url with four separate if-blocks (scheme, path, query, fragment). A reader must work through all four to reconstruct the invariant: 'must be an origin-only URL.' Extract fn require_origin_url(url: &Url) -> Result<(), ClientError> that checks all four conditions and names the constraint in one place, making new() read as: parse -> require_origin_url -> build.
